name: facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_llm/sims/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.initialize_object_state_machine: create an ObjectStateMachine from a Habitat simulator and MetadataInterface with power, clean, and filled states
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.CollaborationSim_init: build a CollaborationSim instance from a DictConfig to manage object states in a Habitat simulation
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.CollaborationSim_object_state_machine: review the CollaborationSim object_state_machine property to access the initialized ObjectStateMachine
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.CollaborationSim_initialize_object_state: run initialize_object_state_machine on CollaborationSim with a CollaborationEpisode to set initial object states
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.CollaborationSim_reconfigure: refactor the CollaborationSim by calling reconfigure with a new DictConfig and CollaborationEpisode to update metadata and states

facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.build_MetadataInterface: build a MetadataInterface instance that loads HSSD object and receptacle metadata from CSV and JSON files
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.create_get_metadata_dict_from_config: create a metadata dict by merging default paths with overrides from an omegaconf config node
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.test_refresh_scene_caches: test the MetadataInterface refresh_scene_caches method to populate receptacle and region semantic name mappings from a simulator
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.review_get_scene_objs_of_class: review the get_scene_objs_of_class method to find all ManagedObject instances of a given semantic class in the scene
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.summarize_get_template_handles_of_class: summarize the get_template_handles_of_class method to query a MetadataMediator for all object template handles of a semantic class
